text:
The plate is a square plate about 340 px wide, so I take it as roughly 24 cm across. That gives about 14 px per cm.

Each corn piece is about 100 px across, or about 7 cm in diameter. Each is a cob segment standing on end, with a height of maybe 3 to 4 cm.

Volume of one segment: π × 3.5² × 3.5 ≈ 135 cm³. The cob is only partly kernel, and the density is about 0.9, so I estimate about 100 g per piece including the cob.

The two pieces together come to about 200 g. Corn on the cob has about 90 kcal per 100 g, but the cob is inedible, so I use a lower value for the whole piece, about 70 kcal per 100 g.

```json
{"items": [{"name": "corn on the cob pieces (2 segments)", "grams": 190, "kcal_per_100g": 70}]}
```
